reden: Yes. The report includes '[High] Buyers inherit the VestingManager's stale stepsClaimed, so locked tokens unlock early or unlocked ones lock again' (and also '[Medium] Pooled escrow entry of the VestingManager gives every buyer the stepsClaimed of the first lister'), which describe the same root cause and code path as H-02: in SecondSwap_StepVesting.transferVesting()/_createVesting(), the pooled VestingManager vesting stores a single stepsClaimed (from the first lister) and never updates it, so new buyers are assigned that stale stepsClaimed. This lets attackers/buyers prematurely unlock tokens or delays their vesting. Fixing stepsClaimed handling per listing/buyer would fix both descriptions.
